task_B_window_sweep.methodological_finding: Crossref query.bibliographic / query.title perform bag-of-words relevance ranking, NOT exact phrase matching -- verified: wrapping the query in double quotes (query.title="just energy transition partnership") returns an IDENTICAL result set/count to the unquoted version (total-results=15104 both times). A broad bag-of-words query against common words ('just','energy','transition') returns tens of thousands of irrelevant hits and only surfaces true JETP items if they rank in the top ~50 by relevance; this is why a precise 'JETP'-acronym-only title search was used as the primary probe for the window, cross-checked against the broader bag-of-words query for phrasings that avoid the acronym.
